stats.text:
When you cast *{ref:spell/find-familiar}*, you infuse the summoned familiar with a measure of your eldritch power, granting the creature the following benefits.

***Aerial or Aquatic.*** The familiar gains either a {ref:glossary/fly-speed} or a {ref:glossary/swim-speed} (your choice) of 40 feet.

***Quick Attack.*** As a {ref:glossary/bonus-action}, you can command the familiar to take the {ref:glossary/attack} action.

***Necrotic or Radiant Damage.*** Whenever the familiar deals Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage, you can make it deal Necrotic or Radiant damage instead.

***Your Save DC.*** If the familiar forces a creature to make a saving throw, it uses your spell save DC.

***Resistance.*** When the familiar takes damage, you can take a {ref:glossary/reaction} to grant it {ref:glossary/resistance} against that damage.
